description: Returns the current college basketball rankings exactly as published on fillmybracket.com/college-basketball-rankings: the AP Top 25, Week 1 (released Monday, November 9, 2026, with first-place votes), the other teams receiving votes, and the Bart Torvik T-Rank model ranks (read November 1, 2026). Rankings as of Monday, November 9, 2026, and every result says so. With no argument, returns the full Top 25 plus the model's own top 10, so the poll-vs-model gaps are visible. With a team name, returns that team's AP rank or votes, its model rank, and any radar or vulnerable-favorite note the site carries for it. A team outside the published data gets a plain not-found: nothing is invented. Real teams and real ranks only; this is current-season data, not the 2027 tournament field, which is set on Selection Sunday, March 14, 2027.

limit.description: Optional: how many of the Top 25 to return, 1 to 25. Default 25.

team.description: Optional: one team name, e.g. 'Duke' or 'Grand Canyon'. Omit for the full Top 25 table.

name: get_rankings
title: Get current rankings
